messages:
Eli (AE): Quick heads-up — Summit Retail expanded the PoC requirements midday: live chat co-pilot + immediate search rerank, plus they must use their own HSM/KMS (BYOK). They want 75 concurrent users and an interactive p95 <= 2s. Can we still hit the 10-business-day PoC? :sweat_smile:
Rina (SE): Live chat + inline rerank + BYOK is doable but non-trivial. Need to know if rerank can be eventual (UI updates after initial reply) or must be strictly in the same request. Also what streaming protocol they expect (WebSocket vs gRPC).
Will (CSM): Customer says UX requires the rerank to be applied before the chat bubble renders for the demo. They prefer WebSocket.
Marco (Infra): BYOK/HSM means network peering or a key-wrapping workflow. For a hosted demo, we can implement ephemeral key wrapping but that requires legal + arch signoff. Otherwise Private/VPC gives us direct KMS access and is faster. For 75 concurrent interactive sessions, recommend Dedicated pool with autoscale margin. Provisioning + KMS link = ~4 days, plus validation tests.
Tanya (Security): Because this is customer-controlled keys and retail PII, we need: signed KMS access policy, proof of KMS audit logs retention, and an updated security questionnaire entry. Hosted with key unwrap needs a design doc and legal risk acceptance.
Eli (AE): Can someone give a short blurb on delta to timeline and cost I can paste into the customer email? Keep it non-technical — procurement wants numbers.
Marco (Infra): Short blurb: "Option A — Dedicated PoC (recommended): adds reserved GPU capacity and direct KMS connectivity; increases cost by an estimated delta and shortens integration risk (approx +3 workdays). Option B — Hosted BYOK prototype: requires secure key-wrapping and legal signoff; longer lead time (approx +2 weeks) and non-standard pricing." Will refine numbers once I run the cost sheet.
Pri (Legal): If they insist on hosted BYOK, we need a signed demo-specific addendum that limits key exposure and specifies no key persistence. Also need SLA exceptions documented.
Rina (SE): Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) Customer provides 50 sample chat transcripts + expected rerank outputs; 2) Synthetic load test at 75 concurrent connections for 10m measuring message-to-render p95; 3) Model/config pinned (e.g., RetailGen-13B quantized v2) and test seed prompts archived; 4) Logs retention: 30 days with redaction rules.
Will (CSM): I'll ask Summit for transcripts and confirm WebSocket. Also checking budget flexibility.
Eli (AE): Can we offer a fallback: demo uses Dedicated + their KMS in VPC, but we leave a short note about hosted-as-an-option later?
Marco (Infra): Yes, fallback Recommended: Dedicated/VPC for PoC. Hosted BYOK is an engineering project — offer as paid pilot afterwards.
Tanya (Security): I'll draft the required security questionnaire snippets and a minimal network diagram for both paths. Pri, I'll loop you in for legal phrasing.
Rina (SE): Quick starter prompts for streaming chat QA (we'll tune with customer examples):
```
- user: "Summarize the last 3 messages and list follow-ups (2 bullets)"
- user: "Given this basket of items, recommend upsell phrasing for a customer"
- user: "Extract product IDs and sentiment, output JSON with keys: items, sentiment"
```
Eli (AE): Nice. Assignments: Marco -> cost + timeline note (EOD tomorrow). Tanya -> security questionnaire + diagram (EOD). Rina -> config/model recommendation + test plan (+48h). Will -> collect transcripts + confirm WS protocol (today). Pri -> draft short hosted-BYOK legal addendum template (+48h).
Will (CSM): Summit replied — they can provide transcripts by EOD and confirm WebSocket. Budget is TBD but procurement wants formal estimate.
Eli (AE): If they agree to Dedicated & VPC with their KMS, we should be able to keep the 10-business-day PoC. If they force hosted BYOK, plan +2 weeks. I'll send them a two-option email after Marco's numbers.
deploy-bot: Action queued: create-reserved-dedicated-pool (pending signed addendum). :package:
Pri (Legal): One more legal note — require an explicit statement that demo keys are used only for encryption and not escrowed. Add that to the addendum.
Tanya (Security): Also require a minimal attestation from their HSM vendor that key export is disabled.
Eli (AE): Great, thanks team. I'll update Summit with the options and target them to choose by EOD tomorrow so we can lock resources. :rocket:
